hypothesis: Adding bounded literal source parents relevant to the question improves answer completeness while preserving correctness and source scope.
population: Pinned ePQA train questions on fresh products outside all protected historical and 44 exposed development source pools.

comparison.baseline: unchanged hybrid retrieval restored to complete source parents
comparison.candidate: workspace-source-coverage-v2, same baseline parents plus at most three bounded literal parents
comparison.pairedOrder: alternate baseline-first and candidate-first by saved case index

offlineMeasures: source-review-designated missing fact units delivered by an added parent with literal body and original-question scope preserved
context additions and unchanged cases; these are not answer-quality gains

answerMeasures.primary: source-supported completeness of the answer to the actual question
separate: factual correctness against available source packet
claim support and correct product/model/question/workflow scope
answerMeasures.blindReview: Neutral version IDs, complete sources including original customer questions, no arm map or retrieval addition reasons; two independent AI assessments, disagreement reported separately.
answerMeasures.referenceLimit: A customer report is a scoped report, not physical verification or universal compatibility. Unsupported exact model relationships and absent spec/timing endpoints remain unknown.
answerMeasures.denominator: All twelve frozen pairs including unchanged retrieval, failed calls and disagreements.
answerMeasures.smallSample: Descriptive paired outcomes only; no population-wide or statistical-significance claim.
answerMeasures.humanReview: Pending until actual source-checked human judgments are saved; AI assessments alone do not establish final quality improvement.

stops: Any frozen code/input drift or selection insufficiency: preserve failure; do not replace cases or reseed.
Zero delivered designated missing fact units: do not prepare or run paid answer calls.
Any live failure or uncertain dispatch: stop; no automatic retries.
activation: No default retrieval change, answer-policy promotion, deployment or autonomous activation.
